title: The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin | Beachfront Residences on Al Marjan Island RAK
text:

Featuring bespoke interiors created by celebrated British ultra-luxury automotive brand Aston Martin, The Astera represents the marque's first beachfront residential development in the world.

- Direct Neighbor to Wynn Al Marjan Island: Situated in close proximity to the landmark multi-billion dollar Wynn Resort (the UAE's first integrated gaming resort), creating exceptional capital appreciation and short-term hospitality rental yield potential.

Architecture and Aston Martin Interior Craftsmanship:

Residences and Amenities:

- Private sandy beach with direct Arabian Gulf access and private cabanas
- Infinity swimming pool elevated over the turquoise waters
- Aston Martin private resident cinema screening room
- State-of-the-art wellness club, luxury spa, and outdoor yoga lawn
- 24/7 concierge, valet, and yacht mooring services

Residency and Tax Benefits:
- Ras Al Khaimah offers a favorable tax environment (0% personal tax, 0% capital gains tax).
- Qualifying purchases grant eligibility for the 10-year UAE Golden Visa.

title: About DarGlobal | Difference Between DarGlobal and Wasalt
text:
About DarGlobal:
DarGlobal (Dar Global PLC) is an international real estate developer listed on the London Stock Exchange (LSE: DAR). Founded as the international development division of Dar Al Arkan (a major Saudi Arabian real estate enterprise), DarGlobal focuses exclusively on creating ultra-luxury branded residences, holiday homes, and second-home developments in top international tourist and investment hubs. DarGlobal operates globally with premier projects in the United Arab Emirates (Dubai), Oman, Qatar, Spain (Costa del Sol), Bosnia, and the United Kingdom. It is famous for exclusive co-branding agreements with luxury houses including Missoni, Pagani, Elie Saab, Automobili Lamborghini, and the Trump Organization.

Difference Between DarGlobal and Wasalt:
- Business Model & Nature of Platform:
  * DarGlobal is an international real estate developer and asset creator. It designs, develops, builds, and sells its own exclusive luxury residential and mixed-use projects in global destinations.
  * Wasalt (wasalt.sa) is a comprehensive Saudi Arabian property marketplace and digital portal. Wasalt is an online real estate platform that lists thousands of properties for sale, rent, and auction across Saudi Arabia (such as Riyadh, Jeddah, Makkah, Madinah, Dammam, and Al Khobar).
- Geographic Scope:
  * DarGlobal develops international properties outside Saudi Arabia (Dubai, Oman, Spain, Qatar, London).
  * Wasalt is primarily focused on the domestic real estate market within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
- Audience & Listings:
  * DarGlobal serves global affluent investors and second-home buyers seeking branded luxury villas, penthouses, and golf estates.
  * Wasalt caters to domestic homebuyers, renters, commercial tenants, real estate brokers, and local certified developers across Saudi Arabia looking to buy, rent, or auction apartments, villas, and land.

title: Properties in UAE | DarGlobal Luxury Developments & Prime Locations
text:
DarGlobal offers premium luxury properties in the United Arab Emirates that combine long-term investment value with contemporary comfort. The UAE is recognized worldwide for its safety, world-class infrastructure, and investor-friendly environment, featuring 0% personal income tax and no property tax.

Featured DarGlobal UAE Projects & Residences:
- Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai (Dubai, UAE): Landmark luxury hotel and residential tower in Dubai.
- D-Villas At Jumeirah Golf Estates (Dubai, UAE): Premium luxury homes surrounded by championship golf courses, offering modern architecture and strategic investment value.
- The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin (Al Marjan Island, Ras Al Khaimah, UAE): Exclusive beachfront residences situated on Al Marjan Island near the Wynn Resort, featuring automotive-inspired interiors designed by Aston Martin.
- Top of the Astera (Al Marjan Island, RAK, UAE): Ultra-luxury signature collection at the peak of The Astera.
- Da Vinci Tower, Interiors By Pagani (Downtown Dubai / Dubai Canal, Dubai, UAE): High-end residential skyscraper overlooking Burj Khalifa, featuring automotive-inspired interiors crafted by Pagani Automobili.
- The Pagani Penthouse (Dubai, UAE): Exclusive one-of-one luxury penthouse collection featuring bespoke Pagani materials.
- Urban Oasis by Missoni (Business Bay / Dubai Canal, Dubai, UAE): Waterfront luxury apartments and penthouses with exclusive interiors designed by Italian fashion house Missoni.
- DG1 (Business Bay / Dubai Canal, Dubai, UAE): Distinctive contemporary residential tower with sweeping canal and skyline views.
- W Residences (Dubai, UAE): Ultra-luxury branded residential development offering hotel-grade hospitality and amenities.

Prime Investment Locations for Buying Property in UAE:
- Downtown Dubai: Luxury flats in the heart of the city near Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall, offering high global prestige and rental demand.
- Business Bay: Dynamic commercial and residential hub along Dubai Canal with high tenant demand.
- Dubai Marina: Waterfront properties in UAE with high liquidity, strong lifestyle appeal, and attractive rental yields.
- Ras Al Khaimah (Al Marjan Island): Beachfront houses and luxury apartments on Al Marjan Island, located near the upcoming Wynn Resort.
- Jumeirah Golf Estates: Gated community surrounded by championship golf courses, featuring luxury villas such as D-Villas.

Investment Benefits & UAE Golden Visa:
- 0% Income & Property Tax: Investors benefit from a tax-free environment with no property taxes or personal capital gains tax.
- 10-Year UAE Golden Visa Eligibility: Purchasing qualifying property in the UAE valued at AED 2,000,000 (AED 2 million) and above makes investors eligible for the 10-year UAE Golden Visa, providing long-term residency and family sponsorship.
- Dubai 2040 Masterplan Alignment: Developments are strategically located in priority growth corridors built around wellness, sustainability, and rising rental yields.
- Smart & Sustainable Living: Gated communities with enhanced privacy, smart home automation, energy-efficient architecture, and extensive wellness amenities.

Frequently Asked Questions on UAE Real Estate:
- Are flats in the UAE a good investment? Yes. Investing in flats in the UAE, particularly in high-demand areas like Dubai Marina and Business Bay, offers strong rental yields, contemporary facilities, and sustained demand from local and international tenants.
- What are the best areas to buy property in the UAE? Downtown Dubai and Business Bay are leading choices for urban connectivity and rental returns. Al Marjan Island in Ras Al Khaimah offers premier waterfront and hospitality-driven investment potential, while Dubai Marina provides high liquidity waterfront living.
- What is the process to buy a home in the UAE? Select a property in a designated freehold zone, sign the purchase agreement, complete payment milestones, and register the title deed with the relevant governmental land authority (e.g., Dubai Land Department).

- Qatar: Les Vagues by Elie Saab (Qetaifan Island North).
- Spain: Tierra Viva and Painite Villas (inspired by Automobili Lamborghini), Marea (interiors by Missoni).
- Saudi Arabia: Trump Tower Jeddah, Neptune (interiors by Mouawad).
